clue.text: Pouting songstress Clark not without love

parts.note: Petula Clark is the British singer of Downtown

indicators.note: without tells us to take the letter for love away from the word not

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis scoring, the letter O

explanation.surface: A sulky singer called Clark is missing her romance.
explanation.definitionFit: A petulant person is sulky and peevish, and pouting is the face that shows that mood.

clue.text: See 24 across
Audition of black horse

indicators.note: an audition is a hearing, so the word for black is to be taken as it sounds

parts.note: night is black, the dark of night

explanation.surface: Someone tries out for the part of a dark stallion.
explanation.walkthrough: In chess the piece shaped like a horse's head is often called the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: The chess piece carved as a horse's head is informally called the horse.

clue.text: Crime needs time and motive

parts.note: a motive is a reason for acting

explanation.surface: A detective's maxim: a crime needs opportunity and motive.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason, betraying one's country, is among the gravest crimes in law.

clue.text: From heaven, English pyramid average?

indicators.note: the tail of pyramid, read as amid, tells us to put the letters before it in the middle of average

parts.note: the mean is the average
the first three letters of pyramid, taken as written

explanation.surface: Is the average English pyramid a gift from the gods?
explanation.walkthrough: The trick is to split the single word 'pyramid' into its opening three letters and the container signal 'amid'.
explanation.definitionFit: Empyrean is an adjective for the highest heaven, so it means celestial or from heaven.

clue.text: Having no complaints when circulating, endlessly doing so?

indicators.note: doing so means circulating, moving around, so the letters themselves are rearranged
endlessly says the word circulating loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone happily going round and round never finds fault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doing so' points back to circulating: the word without its G (CIRCULATIN) is itself sent round, rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone uncritical finds no fault, so has no complaints about anything.

clue.text: One refuting the weight of a couturier's work

definitions.meaning: a person who says something is untrue

definitions.text: the weight of a couturier's work
definitions.meaning: a unit measuring the fineness of silk or nylon yarn, as in tights

explanation.definitionFit: A denier denies claims; separately, denier is the unit of fibre weight used for hosiery.

clue.text: What could make Pierce Brosnan bristle is what makes double agents bristle — not a lot perhaps

definitions.text: What could make Pierce Brosnan bristle is what makes double agents bristle — not a lot perhaps

parts.words: What could make Pierce Brosnan bristle is what makes double agents bristle — not a lot perhaps
parts.note: Brosnan played the spy Bond; a fashion creator could give him a deliberate short growth of facial hair, a little bristle

explanation.surface: A double agent's image consultant plots the right amount of facial hair for a former Bond star.
explanation.walkthrough: Pierce Brosnan played James Bond. The fashionable few days' growth is the look meant here; 'not a lot' says the bristle is short.
explanation.definitionFit: This is deliberately cultivated short facial growth, a fashion look styled as if by a fashion creator.

clue.text: Smart clobber from Mike Tyson: Bruno's heartbroken

indicators.note: the tail of heartbroken: broken letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: heart picks out the middle letter of Bruno

explanation.surface: After beating Frank Bruno, Mike Tyson wears a smart outfit while Bruno is devastated.
explanation.walkthrough: Heartbroken splits in two: 'heart' takes U from BRUNO, and 'broken' rearranges MIKETYSON plus U. Clobber is British slang for clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A monkey suit is slang for formal evening wear such as a dinner suit, the smart clothes meant.

clue.text: See 9
Boat more appropriate for the substance in this privileged vehicle?

definitions.text: Boat more appropriate for the substance in this privileged vehicle?

parts.words: Boat more appropriate for the substance in this privileged vehicle?
parts.note: the sauce poured from a jug-shaped boat would suit a boat better than a vehicle running on rails, yet the easy-money ride is named after it

explanation.surface: Wouldn't the sauce suit a jug better than the cushy carriage it names?
explanation.walkthrough: A gravy boat is the jug gravy is served in, so a boat suits gravy better than a train does.
explanation.definitionFit: A gravy train is an easy source of money or privilege, ridden by those who profit without effort.

clue.text: Cad to refuse evidence of 17s?

parts.note: a rat is a cad, a scoundrel
tat is rubbish, worthless refuse

explanation.surface: A bounder is told to reject proof from door-to-door callers.
explanation.walkthrough: 17 across is KNOCKER: the rapping sound is evidence that a door knocker has been used.
explanation.definitionFit: Rat-tat imitates the rapping noise a door knocker makes, so it is the sound proving one was used.

clue.text: Lentil and bean stew on napkins etc

indicators.note: stew suggests ingredients mixed together, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A vegetarian stew is served on the dinner table with napkins.
explanation.definitionFit: Napkins, tablecloths and placemats are all items of fabric for laying a dining table.

clue.text: Opening piece of open flower

parts.note: overt means open, not hidden
a flower is something that flows, a river; the Ure is a Yorkshire river

explanation.surface: The bloom of a flower is like an opening piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is a river here (it flows): the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: An overture is the orchestral piece that opens an opera or show.

clue.text: See 8
Game where shape of 3's move overbearing?

parts.note: 3 down is the chess knight, which moves in an L shape
across means over, as in to go across or over a bridge
E, east, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: A domineering chess piece moves in a sport.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer to 3 down is the knight, whose move traces an L. 'Overbearing' splits into over, ACROSS, and bearing, E.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacrosse is a team game played with netted sticks.

clue.text: One not 6 of horse slaughterer exchanging article for duck

indicators.note: exchanging one for another tells us to swap one letter for the other

parts.note: a knacker buys and slaughters worn-out horses
a is the indefinite article
a duck is zero in cricket, the letter O

explanation.surface: An abattoir worker swaps a bit of writing for a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 6 down is UNCRITICAL; one not uncritical is a critic, someone who knocks things.
explanation.definitionFit: A knocker is a persistent critic, the opposite of someone with no complaints.

clue.text: Work out tax the Queen's saved

indicators.note: saved means kept inside, so one piece is held within the other

parts.note: excise is a tax on goods
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: The monarch has stashed away tax money once all is reckoned up.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise is to work out, training the body by physical activity.

clue.text: Wasting of a prize

parts.note: a trophy is a prize won

explanation.surface: Squandering a prize.
explanation.definitionFit: Atrophy is wasting away of body tissue or a muscle, used here as a noun.

clue.text: Half orchestral section's input contrived to blow

indicators.note: contrived means artfully arranged, so the letters are rearranged
half tells us to keep only one half of the word for the orchestra section

parts.note: percussion is the drums section of an orchestra
to input something is to put it in

explanation.surface: The drummers' contribution produced an engineered blast.
explanation.walkthrough: Half of PERCUSSION (ten letters) is PERCU; with PUT these letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An uppercut is a boxing blow driven upward at the opponent's chin.

clue.text: Skip a page turned over, referred to many times

indicators.note: turned over says the whole run is read backwards

parts.note: to miss is to skip

explanation.surface: A reader skips a page and flips it over, though it is often cited.
explanation.definitionFit: Passim, Latin for throughout, marks a source cited at many places in a text.

clue.text: Playgirl's fiction project passed round

definitions.note: the definition is the girl in a play plus 's, read as 'is'

indicators.note: passed round tells us one word goes around the other

parts.note: to jut is to project or stick out
a lie is a fiction, an untruth

explanation.surface: A glamorous woman's novel project was passed around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Playgirl' is a girl in a play: Juliet, of Romeo and Juliet. The 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Juliet is the heroine of Shakespeare's play Romeo and Juliet, a girl from a play.

clue.text: Bird eats prune and banger

indicators.note: eats means takes inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a jay is a bird of the crow family
to lop is to prune branches

explanation.surface: A bird eats a dried plum and a sausage.
explanation.walkthrough: Banger is British slang both for a sausage and for an old, battered car; the car is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: A jalopy is an old, decrepit car, the same thing as a banger in British slang.

clue.text: Description of bap containing Inuit, or Arctic tern, we hear?

definitions.meaning: a bread bun or bap with an Inuit person inside, reading the term for Inuit and a roll
said aloud, Arctic tern is Arctic turn, the capsize-and-right move in a kayak

explanation.surface: A sandwich filled with an Inuit or an Arctic seabird sounds odd.
explanation.walkthrough: A bap is a soft bread roll in Britain. The kayak manoeuvre is an Arctic 'turn', so the bird sounds right.
explanation.definitionFit: An Eskimo roll is a kayak manoeuvre of capsizing and righting, literally a roll with an Inuit inside.

clue.text: Cosmetic surgery — might this get you laid?

definitions.meaning: an operation tightening the skin of the ...
the question jokes that improving your looks might win you a sexual partner

explanation.definitionFit: A face-lift is cosmetic surgery to smooth wrinkles, and it may boost someone's appeal.

clue.text: Seasonal slump?

parts.note: a drop or tumble, which is also the American name for autumn

explanation.definitionFit: Fall is both a drop or slump and the American word for autumn, a season.

clue.text: Muscle again crushing mushroom

indicators.note: crushing means squeezing around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: bis means again or twice, a call for an encore
a cep is an edible mushroom, the porcino

explanation.surface: A fitness fanatic repeatedly squashes a mushroom.
explanation.definitionFit: The biceps is the large muscle at the front of the upper arm.

clue.text: Unfavourable review of "Road to" movie starring Bing Crosby only?

definitions.meaning: a verdict that something is useless or awful

definitions.text: "Road to" movie starring Bing Crosby only?
definitions.meaning: the Road to films starred Bing Crosby with Bob Hope, so one without Bob would lack him

explanation.surface: A critic pans a Road to film that features only Bing Crosby.
explanation.definitionFit: Hopeless means very bad or useless, as a damning review might say; a Road film lacking Bob would be Hope-less.
